messages:
Meera P.: kicking off a synthetic i18n golden update for the new quantized model bring-up. want to lock down sampling, dedupe, and labeler instructions. can we run a small canary before full rollout?
Jon L.: 👍 which locales are we prioritizing? and how many golden candidates?
Meera P.: primary locales: en, es, fr, pt-BR, ja, ko, zh-CN, ar. target ~2k golden candidates, with a 200-sample canary split (10%). keep canary stratified by locale and model failure mode.
Sara K.: for sampling, do we use freq-based + semantic cluster oversample? previously longform legal/finance tails broke quant checks.
Ben W.: yes — cluster oversample for underrepresented intents. also add a tokenizer-token-length bucket so we stress longctx paths on q4b. q4b shows KV cache boundary effects at ~1024 tokens.
Meera P.: good call. include buckets: short(<128), med(128-512), long(512-2048). labeler instructions need examples for hallucination vs omission vs formatting errors.
LabelBot: reminder: current labeler queue `golden-i18n-v2` threshold = 75/min, SLA 48h. you can update with `/queue update golden-i18n-v2 threshold=120` if needed.
Jon L.: proposed dedupe: fuzzyhash + embedding-locality + URL-normalization. we should snapshot fingerprint before synthetic augmentation so backfills don't collide.
Meera P.: agreed. pipeline sketch: ingest -> fingerprint snapshot -> synthetic augmentation (i18n paraphrases + length variants) -> dedupe -> sampling -> canary split -> labeler queue.
Sara K.: can we keep an audit column with `orig_sample_id`, `fingerprint_v1`, and `augment_tag` for provenance? that made backfills easier last quarter.
Ben W.: for canary model, route to `q4b-canary-v0.9` and fallback to `q4b-hosted-compat` on tokenization mismatch. add metric hooks: token-error-rate, hallucination-rate (labeler binary), avg_latency_per_token.
Meera P.: here's the sampling command I'll run for the canary subset (small dry-run):
```
python tools/sample_i18n.py --from=refbank_v3 --locales=en,es,fr,pt-BR,ja,ko,zh-CN,ar --size=200 --strata=length,cluster --dedupe=true --out=canary_200.json
```
Jon L.: can you attach the canary json here after dry-run? i'll run the quant smokebench and tokenization pass.
Meera P.: will do. timeline: dry-run today, canary label pass tomorrow, metrics review Thu EOD. tagging @Sara K. and @Ben W. for review.
Sara K.: i can draft labeler guidelines now — will include 8 short examples per error class and locale-specific notes (esp. zh/ja tokenization gotchas).
Ben W.: i'll add the bench config: 5k token step, 3 seeds, measure p99 latency & token-efficiency. will post results in this thread.
LabelBot: queue `golden-i18n-v2` updated: threshold -> 120/min (triggered by Meera P.).
Meera P.: perfect. one more: avoid synthetic paraphrase that changes named entities — we want entity-stable paraphrasing for golden. note added to augment pipeline.
Jon L.: noted. anything else?
Meera P.: if no blockers i'll run dry-run at 15:00 PDT. ping here when done. :rocket:
